english.note: Use 捐款 specifically for money given to a cause or people in need.
Use 捐款 as the all-purpose noun for a monetary donation or contribution.

english.meaning: money or goods for the needy
english.note: Use this for money donated to people in need or raised for charity.

examples.english: My contribution to this disaster-relief drive was five hundred dollars.
examples.traditional: 今次賑災行動，我捐款五百蚊。
examples.jyutping: gam1 ci3 zan3 zoi1 hang4 dung6 ngo5 gyun1 fun2 ng5 baak3 man1

examples.english: I made a donation to this event.
examples.traditional: 我捐咗一筆捐款俾今次活動。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 gyun1 zo2 jat1 bat1 gyun1 fun2 bei2 gam1 ci3 wut6 dung6

examples.english: We collected a lot of charity donations this time.
examples.traditional: 今次籌款活動收到好多捐款。
examples.jyutping: gam1 ci3 cau4 fun2 wut6 dung6 sau1 dou2 hou2 do1 gyun1 fun2
